title: Positive-measure chart pieces have a coordinate projection of positive measure
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝⁿ be open, and let ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+ℓ} be C¹ on V with Dψ(u) injective for every u ∈ V. If T ⊆ V has Lebesgue outer measure Lⁿ(T) > 0, then there is J ⊆ Fin(n+ℓ) with exactly n elements such that Hⁿ(coordinateProjection J (ψ(T))) > 0. Here Hⁿ = μHE[n] (outer measure), and coordinateProjection J is the orthogonal projection onto span{e_j : j ∈ J}.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V T : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn (n + ℓ)), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → (∀ u ∈ V, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ u)) → T ⊆ V → 0 < volume T → ∃ J : Finset (Fin (n + ℓ)), J.card = n ∧ 0 < μHE[n] (coordinateProjection J '' (ψ '' T))
